name: custom-kanban

frames.best_why: Full four-column board at rest with every card and count visible and no dragged card over the columns.

tagline: Drag task cards between four dark columns onto a drop line.
summary: A dark task board with Backlog, TODO, In progress and Complete columns. Cards are dragged from one column to another, counts update, and dropping on the trash zone deletes a card.
appearance: A charcoal full-screen board holding four narrow columns, each headed by a small coloured label and a number. Under each heading sit short dark cards with pale text, a faint outline and an 'Add card' line, with a square trash drop zone at the far right.
behaviour: Dragging a card lifts it out of its column and shows a thin violet drop line between cards. Dropping drops it into the nearest gap and the column counts change; hovering a column tints its background and dragging onto the trash zone swaps the bin for a bouncing flame.
demo_content: Task cards like 'Refactor context providers to a store', 'SOX compliance checklist' and 'Postmortem for outage'.
search_phrases: drag card to trash to delete
columns with task cards and counts
use_when: Tasks move through stages such as backlog, todo, doing and done by dragging cards between columns.
avoid_when: Drag only works with a mouse and the board scrolls sideways, so narrow screens and keyboard users are poorly served.
customise: Card titles and columns are fixed in a DEFAULT_CARDS array inside the file; colours, widths and headings all need source edits.
weight_why: A few dozen DOM nodes with one layout animation per drag; idle otherwise.

a11y.note: Cards move only by mouse drag and are not focusable, so the board cannot be operated from the keyboard, and the icons have no labels.

issues: The left Backlog column and the right trash zone are clipped by the frame edges.
Moving a card has no keyboard equivalent; it relies entirely on mouse drag.
polish_why: Working drag and drop with clean spacing, but the columns are clipped and the styling is plain.
title: Custom Kanban
